concept: Cosmic arcade energy for Astro Fun World: a vivid royal-blue primary rockets across bright off-white space, sparked by sunny electric-yellow pops and a magenta secondary for that primary-color carnival thrill. Friendly navy ink keeps everything readable and grounded while light blue tints map out the play zones.
contrastNotes: All AA targets verified. ink #131C44 on bg 15.83:1 (>=7); ink-soft #454F7C on bg 7.59:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #2A41D8 7.38:1 (>=4.5); primary-dark #2032A6 on bg 9.78:1 (>=4.5); accent #FFD21E on #000 14.49:1 (>=3, bright pop on dark heroes); white on secondary #D6219B 4.62:1. surface-alt #E9EEFF is a LIGHT blue tint close to bg: ink on surface-alt 14.20:1 (>=7) and ink-soft on surface-alt 6.81:1 (>=4.5) so dark text holds on painted section backgrounds.
